map.输入日龄与血清总胆红素，按 Bhutani 列线图判定风险分区，并显示光疗/换血: Enter age in hours and total serum bilirubin; Bhutani nomogram assigns risk zone and shows phototherapy/exchange thresholds. Supports mg/dL and μmol/L toggle.
map.「输入日龄与血清总胆红素，按 Bhutani 列线图判定风险分区，并显示光疗/换: The newborn jaundice hour-bilirubin curve, by entering age in hours and TSB, assigns risk zone via the Bhutani nomogram and shows phototherapy/exchange thresholds, supporting mg/dL and μmol/L toggle, outputs results from the input parameters.
map.⚠️ 本工具为新生儿黄疸风险分层辅助工具，仅供医学人员快速估算，不替代临床检查与: ⚠️ This tool is a newborn-jaundice risk-stratification aid for medical staff quick estimation only; it does not replace clinical exam or physician decisions. Critical/high-risk infants should be managed per neonatal protocols immediately.
map.Bhutani 列线图风险分区（按日龄百分位）: Bhutani Nomogram Risk Zones (by hour-age percentile)
map.75-95 百分位 → 中高危区（橙）：建议随访 24h: 75-95 percentile -> high-intermediate zone (orange): follow up in 24h
map.40-75 百分位 → 中低危区（黄）：可随访: 40-75 percentile -> low-intermediate zone (yellow): can follow up
map.光疗/换血阈值随胎龄与高危因素降低。本工具采用 AAP 2022 简化阈值。: Phototherapy/exchange thresholds drop with gestational age and high-risk factors. This tool uses simplified AAP 2022 thresholds.
map.Bhutani 约 40–75 分位；低风险光疗阈值≈12 mg/dL → 超标: Bhutani ~40-75 percentile; low-risk phototherapy threshold ≈12 mg/dL -> exceeds needs phototherapy.
